source_title: Steve Smith to miss cricket until December after neck injury diagnosis - India Today
source_excerpt:
Steve Smith has been ruled out of the Cape Town Test after scans confirmed a neck injury, with Australia expecting him to return in December. His absence has forced a reshuffle, but the visitors have responded strongly with the bat.
Steve Smith will not be available for selection until Australia's home Test series against New Zealand in December after scans confirmed a cervical facet joint injury, ruling him out of the ongoing series decider against South Africa in Cape Town.
The 37-year-old experienced neck pain on the fourth day of the second Test in Gqeberha last week. Despite hopes that he would recover in time for the third Test at Newlands, Smith failed a late fitness test on Tuesday morning and was withdrawn from the playing XI.
Cricket Australia confirmed the diagnosis on Thursday, stating that an MRI had detected an injury to a cervical facet joint, which helps guide and stabilise movement in the neck.
"Steve Smith developed neck pain on day four of the second Test in Gqeberha last week. Subsequent MRI imaging confirmed a cervical facet joint injury. Due to this and his limited range of motion he was unfit to participate in the current Test," Cricket Australia said in a statement.
"Steve will continue to receive treatment and rehabilitation, with a full return to availability anticipated for the upcoming home Test series against New Zealand."
Smith's absence forced Australia to reshuffle their batting order for the series decider. Cameron Green moved up to No. 4, Smith's usual position, while Josh Inglis was recalled to bat at No. 5. Matthew Renshaw returned to the opening position alongside Travis Head.
The changes yielded dividends on the second day at Newlands on Wednesday, as Australia fought back after losing two quick wickets.
Replying to South Africa's first-innings total of 329, Australia reached 330 for four at stumps, taking a slender one-run lead. Renshaw scored 74, while Green made 65 as the pair added 126 runs for the third wicket to steady the innings.
Inglis then made an unbeaten 85, with Alex Carey also not out on 51. The pair added an unbroken stand to take Australia past South Africa's total and put the visitors in a strong position in the series decider.
Australia are now targeting Smith's return for the first Test against New Zealand, which begins in Perth on December 9. The veteran batter will continue his recovery and rehabilitation in the coming weeks.
The four-match series against New Zealand will be an important part of Australia's home summer, with a demanding run of Test cricket to follow. Australia will also be travelling to India in January next year for the much-awaited five-match Test series against Shubman Gill's side. - Ends
hi_body:
स्कैन में सर्वाइकल फेसेट जोइंट की चोट की पुष्टि होने के बाद ऑस्ट्रेलियाई बल्लेबाज स्टीव स्मिथ को केप टाउन में दक्षिण अफ्रीका के खिलाफ चल रहे सीरीज के निर्णायक टेस्ट मैच से बाहर कर दिया गया है। क्रिकेट ऑस्ट्रेलिया ने घोषणा की है कि दिसंबर में न्यूजीलैंड के खिलाफ होने वाली घरेलू टेस्ट सीरीज के लिए स्मिथ के मैदान पर लौटने की उम्मीद है।

### चोट और निदान का विवरण
* **खिलाड़ी:** स्टीव स्मिथ (आयु 37 वर्ष)
* **चोट:** सर्वाइकल फेसेट जोइंट की चोट जिससे गर्दन की गति और मूवमेंट प्रभावित हुई
* **समयसीमा:** गक्वेबरहा में दूसरे टेस्ट के चौथे दिन गर्दन में दर्द महसूस हुआ; केप टाउन टेस्ट से पहले फिटनेस टेस्ट में असफल रहे
* **वापसी की उम्मीद:** दिसंबर, 9 दिसंबर से पर्थ में शुरू होने वाली न्यूजीलैंड के खिलाफ पहली टेस्ट सीरीज का लक्ष्य

### मैच का संदर्भ और टीम में बदलाव
* **प्रतियोगिता:** ऑस्ट्रेलिया और दक्षिण अफ्रीका के बीच टेस्ट सीरीज का निर्णायक मुकाबला
* **स्थान:** न्यूलैंड्स, केप टाउन
* **प्रारूप:** अंतरराष्ट्रीय टेस्ट क्रिकेट
* **बल्लेबाजी में बदलाव:** कैमरन ग्रीन चौथे नंबर पर आए, जोश इंग्लिस को पांचवें नंबर पर बुलाया गया, और मैथ्यू रेनशॉ ट्रेविस हेड के साथ ओपनिंग करने लौटे।

### मैच की स्थिति और स्कोर
* **दक्षिण अफ्रीका पहली पारी:** 329 रन पर ऑल आउट
* **ऑस्ट्रेलिया पहली पारी:** दूसरे दिन का खेल समाप्त होने पर 4 विकेट पर 330 रन
* **प्रमुख प्रदर्शन:** मैथ्यू रेनशॉ (74), कैमरन ग्रीन (65), जोश इंग्लिस (85 नाबाद), और एलेक्स कैरी (51 नाबाद)
* **मैच की स्थिति:** दूसरा दिन समाप्त, ऑस्ट्रेलिया के पास एक रन की बढ़त

### व्यावहारिक निहितार्थ और सत्यापन
प्रशंसक और विश्लेषक आधिकारिक क्रिकेट ऑस्ट्रेलिया की वेबसाइट या अधिकृत खेल प्रसारण नेटवर्क के माध्यम से आधिकारिक टीम घोषणाओं, चोट के अपडेट और आगामी मैच के कार्यक्रमों की पुष्टि कर सकते हैं। स्मिथ न्यूजीलैंड श्रृंखला से पहले पुनर्वास प्रक्रिया से गुजरेंगे।

en_body:
Australia batter Steve Smith has been ruled out of the ongoing Test series decider against South Africa in Cape Town after scans confirmed a cervical facet joint injury. Cricket Australia announced that Smith is expected to return to competitive cricket in December for the home Test series against New Zealand.

### Injury and Diagnosis Details
* **Player:** Steve Smith (age 37)
* **Injury:** Cervical facet joint injury affecting neck movement and range of motion
* **Timeline:** Experienced neck pain on day four of the second Test in Gqeberha; failed a late fitness test ahead of the Cape Town Test
* **Expected Return:** December, targeting the first Test against New Zealand starting December 9 in Perth

### Match Context and Lineup Changes
* **Competition:** Test series decider between Australia and South Africa
* **Venue:** Newlands, Cape Town
* **Format:** International Test Cricket
* **Batting Adjustments:** Cameron Green moved to No. 4, Josh Inglis recalled at No. 5, and Matthew Renshaw returned as opener alongside Travis Head.

### Match Status and Score
* **South Africa 1st Innings:** 329 all out
* **Australia 1st Innings:** 330 for 4 at stumps on the second day
* **Key Performers:** Matthew Renshaw (74), Cameron Green (65), Josh Inglis (85 not out), and Alex Carey (51 not out)
* **Match Status:** Completed second day of play, with Australia holding a one-run lead

### Practical Implications and Verification
Fans and analysts can verify official team announcements, injury updates, and upcoming match schedules directly through the official Cricket Australia website or accredited sports broadcasting networks. Smith will undergo rehabilitation ahead of the New Zealand series.
